column3: “Both yesterday and three days ago” is rendered “Previously,” and “led out and brought” as “led Israel out and in.”
The Hebrew “saying” before David’s inability is rendered “thinking,” and “will turn you aside” as “shall turn you away.”
NASB rearranges the difficult Hebrew so that the attacker reaches “the lame and the blind … through the water tunnel.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
“Went going and becoming great” is rendered “became greater and greater,” and NASB adds “for.”
“Craftsmen of wood and craftsmen of the stone of a wall” is rendered “carpenters and stonemasons.”
“Bursting out of water” is rendered “breakthrough of waters”; “someone called” is rendered “he named.”
NASB adds “directly” to “You shall not go up.”
“Act decisively” is rendered “act promptly,” and “camp” as “army.”
